Container.Name: Shipmate
Container.Overview: A self-hosted crew of AI bots for everyday life and for work. One Captain coordinates, recruits and delegates to crew members you shape yourself; chat in the web app or on Discord, run scheduled Watches, and let the Shipyard work on GitHub projects in sandboxed containers. Several logins per instance with usage and cost tracked per person.[br][br]One container: the database is built in and kept in the Data folder. To use your own PostgreSQL instead, set DATABASE_URL.[br][br]Source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license: free for noncommercial use. It is not open source; commercial use needs a separate license.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app and API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything Shipmate keeps: the built-in database (postgres/), crew, skills, workspaces, the generated encryption key (.secret) and backups (backups/). Keep it on a cache/pool disk the mover leaves alone.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Optional. Lets the Shipyard run code in per-project sandbox containers. Remove it to keep the Shipyard off. Anything with this socket controls Docker on the host.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to use the database built into Shipmate (kept in the Data folder, under postgres/). Or your own Postgres 15 or newer: postgres://user:password@host:port/database. Installs that already point at a Postgres container keep working as they are.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_URL
Config.Description: The address people open Shipmate at, with no path (used for links, webhooks and sign-in redirects). Behind a reverse proxy, the proxy's https address, e.g. https://shipmate.example.com; then sign in there, not at the IP and port.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Key that encrypts stored API keys and tokens. Leave empty to generate one on first start (kept in /data/.secret). If you set it, keep it forever: without it stored secrets cannot be read, even from a backup.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_HOST_DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Optional. Host path of the Data folder above (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/shipmate), used for sandbox bind mounts. Usually detected automatically.

Config.Name: DOCKER_HOST
Config.Description: Optional, instead of the Docker socket: where Shipyard sandboxes run, e.g. tcp://sandbox-host.lan:2376 (a Docker or Podman host) or unix:///run/podman/podman.sock. The owner can also set this in Settings, Shipyard sandbox.

Config.Name: DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
Config.Description: Optional. Set to 1 to connect to a tcp:// DOCKER_HOST with the TLS client certificates in DOCKER_CERT_PATH.

Config.Name: DOCKER_CERT_PATH
Config.Description: Optional. Folder inside the container with ca.pem, cert.pem and key.pem for a remote sandbox host, e.g. /data/sandbox-certs.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_SANDBOX_WORKSPACES
Config.Description: Optional. Where a remote sandbox host sees Shipmate's workspaces folder (shared over NFS), e.g. /mnt/shipmate/workspaces.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_BACKUP_DIR
Config.Description: Optional. Where backups are written inside the container (default /data/backups). Map another path (e.g. a share) to it to keep backups off the appdata disk.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_SANDBOX_IMAGE
Config.Description: Optional. Default image for Shipyard sandboxes (e.g. node:22-bookworm).

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_OLLAMA_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Address of an Ollama server for local models (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434). Shipmate checks it on the Providers page and in first-run setup.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_UPDATE_CHECK
Config.Description: on or off. The Health page checks GitHub for a newer release; off never contacts GitHub (offline installs).

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_MCP
Config.Description: on or off. off skips starting MCP servers for crew sessions (air-gapped installs).

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Which reverse proxies Shipmate believes about the browser's address and https. The default trusts proxies on this server, Docker networks and the LAN (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Cloudflare Tunnel). Add a proxy's public IP if it reaches Shipmate over the internet; off trusts none.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Server log level: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace.
